correctness.rationale: The 12 integral forms and 12 contact points satisfy the exact fourth-contact polynomial identity. Exact Gaussian arithmetic checks all 220 nonzero triple determinants and gives norm support only at rational primes 2, 3, 5, eliminating every other exceptional prime. Gaussian-primitive cross products define all 66 marked sections over Z[i]. Exhaustive exact residue calculations at 3 (F9), both primes at 5 (F5), and 2 (F2) yield the stated complete weight partitions; direct polynomial factorization gives the quartic special fibers, and the Hermitian tangent argument explains the 28-point setting in characteristic 3. All steps and assumptions appear in RESULT.md; the packaged verifier was actually executed successfully. These are finite exhaustive certificates for a finite integral model, with a determinant proof covering infinitely many good primes, not unsupported numerical extrapolations.

value.rationale: This is the complete exceptional-characteristic and marked-incidence degeneration for the distinguished twelve undulation lines of a classical special genus-three quartic. The 66 Gaussian-primitive section specializations encode geometrically meaningful collision data (not arbitrary selected moduli slices): a Hermitian symmetry jump, two distinct prime-five specializations to four component lines, and a characteristic-two nonreduced quartic. Separating 66 marked labels from 36, 18 and 7 support points is a structural refinement needed for arithmetic specialization studies; it is not a restatement of the previously known characteristic-zero 66-node or dual 30+6 counts.
